result.summary: The page appears largely intact. The visible right-edge clipping in the category chips and restaurant carousel, plus the partially visible bottom card, are consistent with scroll/viewport behavior and were excluded per instructions. No clear critical or major visual defects are present; only a minor contrast/readability consideration for secondary gray metadata text.

issues.description: Secondary metadata such as delivery fees and the '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' line use light gray text that may be harder to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Slightly darken secondary text or increase font weight/size to improve contrast while preserving the visual hierarchy.
